opportunities.name: Movie ratings lookup (IMDb + Rotten Tomatoes) and email a movie-night invite
opportunities.description: Look up a movie on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes for rating, director and runtime, then draft a movie-night email with those details to a recipient.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open the title page
Note IMDb rating, director, runtime
Search the same title on Rotten Tomatoes and open the result
Note Tomatometer score
Open new mail message
Enter recipient in To
Enter subject 'Movie night <day>: <movie>'
Write body with director, runtime, IMDb rating and Tomatometer
Discard/send the draft

instances.values: Spirited Away; tom@example.com; Saturday; IMDb 8.6, TM 96%

opportunities.name: npm package lookup and note-taking of stats
opportunities.description: Search a package on npm, open its page and GitHub repo releases, then save a summary note (version, downloads, license, stars, issues, last release).
steps: Search the package name on npm
Open the package page
Read version, weekly downloads, license
Open the GitHub repository link
Open Releases and check stars, open issues, last release
Add a note in Notes with the summary

instances.values: express (lookup only, not completed to note)

opportunities.description: Search a dish on Allrecipes, open the top recipe, check the dish's origin on Wikipedia, then add a note with servings, rating, time, ingredients and origin.
steps: Search dish on Allrecipes

Search dish on Wikipedia to find origin
Add note in Notes summarizing the dish, rating, time, ingredients and origin
